listing.description: Views That Inspire a Reset *New roof *New kitchen *New tankless water heater *New hardwood floors *New windows *New decks *Newly landscaped, usable yard, with mature apricot, apple and lemon trees *Remodeled bathrooms *Freshly painted interior and exterior *New central heating *New RING audio video *Parking for 4+ cars *1.6 miles from the shops and restaurants of Montclair Village *Just 7.5 miles to the Bay Bridge *Work completed by licensed contractors and permitted AND SO MUCH MORE! This one-of-a-kind, sun-drenched home in the Montclair Hills is perched above the Bay, with sweeping views from both floors and a deck that spans the width of the home. The Bay is on full display, with views of San Francisco, the Golden Gate Bridge, the Bay Bridge, and the San Rafael Bridge, along with Alcatraz, Sausalito, Angel Island, Tiburon, Emeryville, and the Berkeley Marina. This is a home you have to experience in person.
